subject.title: fix: allow configuring Slack App Home copy

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public Slack `appHome` config and SDK type for branded Home copy and disabling Home publishing, or should this PR be narrowed to only making the default usage line honor `slashCommand.name`?
rationale: The implementation is now plausibly bounded, but adding operator-facing Slack configuration and SDK surface is a product/API contract decision that tests and CI cannot settle.

options.title: Approve bounded appHome config
options.body: Accept the new config surface after redacted real Slack proof confirms configured copy and disabled publishing.

options.title: Narrow to fallback copy
options.body: Remove the public `appHome` block and only make the default Home usage text follow the configured slash command name.

options.title: Defer Home customization
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose a broader Slack Home customization or dashboard direction.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded appHome config
recommendation.body: Accept the new config surface after redacted real Slack proof confirms configured copy and disabled publishing.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the merged Slack App Home base implementation and current Home handler surface this PR extends.
